pullRequests.title: fix(index): accept GitHub's asset digest without SHA256SUMS
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/index-github-digest
pullRequests.body:
The index now takes GitHub's digest as an archive's hash, so SHA256SUMS is optional.
If both exist they must match; with neither, a native release is still skipped.

pullRequests.title: fix(mods): credit each mod's first committer as its author
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/mods-first-author
pullRequests.body:
Replaces "OpenRAC contributors" in each mod's manifest with whoever made its first commit.
Archipelago's APWorld credits change too; copyright headers stay.

pullRequests.title: fix(submit): say that pictures can stay as GitHub writes them, drop the wizard
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/screenshots-form-wording
pullRequests.body: Mod author feedback on the submission form, with the matching site change in OpenRAC/openrac-site. Screenshots. Pasting a picture makes GitHub write , but the placeholder showed ![shot](…) | caption, so the author rewrote each line by hand. pictures() already accepted the form, so parsing does not change. This updates the wording in both forms and in the bot's check message, and says that links to pictures hosted elsewhere…

commits.headline: fix(submit): say that pictures can stay as GitHub writes them, drop the wizard (#40)
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body: Pasting a picture makes GitHub write an tag, while the Screenshots placeholder showed ![shot](...), so an author rewrote each line by hand. The bot already took both. The forms and the bot's message now say to leave the line as it is, and that links to pictures elsewhere don't work. Tests pin all of this. The wizard at openrac.dev/mods/submit is going away, so the form, its chooser and the README stop pointing at it. The form now says what a mod needs first. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus…
